Class UserAccessToken

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.entities.BaseID<Integer>
grafiosch.entities.UserBaseID
grafiosch.entities.UserAccessToken
@Entity public class UserAccessToken extends UserBaseID
A personal access token with which a machine client - for example an AI assistant - authenticates on the paths the application opens for it. Only the SHA-256 hash of the token is stored; the token itself is shown to the user exactly once, in the answer to its creation.

The entity is never serialized. The REST layer works with its own transfer objects, so neither the hash nor the entity reach a client. Tokens are not exported with "export my data": a hash is worthless on another instance. The account deletion removes them.

A token is never changed after it was created. A different name, scope or lifetime means revoking it and creating a new one.

The same table holds the tokens issued to OAuth clients (AccessTokenKind.OAUTH_ACCESS, AccessTokenKind.OAUTH_REFRESH). They belong to an OAuthAuthorization, carry the client's name as token name and are removed together with it.

    • forOAuth

      public static UserAccessToken forOAuth(OAuthAuthorization authorization, AccessTokenKind kind, String tokenHash, String tokenPrefix, LocalDateTime createdAt, LocalDateTime expiresAt)
      Creates a token issued to an OAuth client.
      Parameters:
      authorization - the family the token belongs to
      kind - AccessTokenKind.OAUTH_ACCESS or AccessTokenKind.OAUTH_REFRESH
      tokenHash - SHA-256 of the token
      tokenPrefix - the first characters of the token
      createdAt - UTC
      expiresAt - UTC, never after the end of the family

    • hashToken

      public static String hashToken(String plainToken)
      Hashes a token the way it is stored. A token carries 256 bits of randomness, so a fast hash suffices and keeps the authentication of every request at a single index lookup.
      Parameters:
      plainToken - the token in clear text
      Returns:
      SHA-256 as 64 lower case hex characters
